cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll feed the little demon. You get our curtains out of its mouth. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It appeared when you read that novelty mug aloud.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Those mugs say all sorts. I'll fetch crackers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only eats words. It's chewing the lease.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll swap in the mug and save our deposit. No need to preserve every possible clue.

mechanism: A leads managing a word-eating demon, accepts B discovered diet and feeds it the causal mug while rescuing the lease.
confusable: Unlike merely solving an odd problem, A deflects B attribution and chooses a solution that consumes the evidence of A casual reading.
comparison: Destroying the summoning object through feeding differs from blaming a toaster during a gravity rescue.
seedUse: D157-b read-aloud mug, demon diet and lease; S02-b adapts feeding help and work allocation to B facts.
